'''1997 Coruscant Regionals (Pittsburgh)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Coruscant region (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="nf97cor">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/coruscantqualifier.html Malec Triumphs At Star Wars CCG Coruscant II Qualifier], Vince Medvid, Decipher NewsFlash (3 June 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607092018/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/coruscantqualifier.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Malec and Sollman both went 5–1 over three rounds and met in a two-game final, which Malec won by a total of +47.<ref name="nf97cor" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Coruscant)
* '''Date:''' 24 May 1997
* '''Site:''' Greentree Marriott, Three Rivers Gamefest, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Bill Gilson]], assisted by [[Kendrick Summers]]
